analyst.text: Washington have lost five straight after Wednesday's 114-101 loss in Indiana, and they play this game on a back-to-back. Anthony Davis has already called out the team's defense. Detroit beat them 122-111 only three days ago and have won seven of the last nine meetings. The Pistons are missing Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe, but confidence and freshness both lean toward Detroit.
